policy: Public GET routes that accept precise location, field-like references, or upstream-provider calls must be classified. Any future DB-backed field/farm/user/tenant access must move to authenticated endpoints.

/api/v1/weather/current.contract: Open-Meteo current-weather calculator by lat/lon only; no tenant DB access; in-app and nginx rate-limited.

/api/v1/weather/forecast.contract: Open-Meteo forecast calculator by lat/lon/days only; no tenant DB access; in-app and nginx rate-limited.

/api/v1/weather/historical.contract: Open-Meteo archive calculator by lat/lon/date range only; no tenant DB access; in-app and nginx rate-limited.

/api/v1/weather/probe.contract: Map probe by lat/lon; derived weather/agronomy output; no tenant DB access.

/api/v1/weather/operation-window.contract: Operation suitability by lat/lon/operation; no tenant DB access; in-app rate-limited.

/api/v1/weather/operation-plan.contract: Multi-operation suitability by lat/lon; no tenant DB access; in-app rate-limited.

/api/v1/weather/field-weather-summary.contract: Field-shaped weather summary by supplied lat/lon/crop context only; no authoritative tenant field lookup.

/api/v1/weather/action-recommendation.contract: Accepts client_field_ref only as an opaque draft label. It must not dereference fields/farms/tenants in DB; use authenticated task/recommendation endpoints for authoritative field IDs.

/api/v1/weather/alerts.contract: Weather-derived alerts by lat/lon/crop context only; no tenant DB access.

/api/v1/geo-locate/field.contract: Location helper by user-supplied lat/lon; must remain calculation/reference only unless authenticated.

/api/v1/geo-locate/recommend.contract: Location recommendation helper by user-supplied lat/lon; must remain calculation/reference only unless authenticated.
